title: Théorie de Kumer ? + note Alexandre (bi tenseur…) : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page is a sketch of Kummer theory for μ_n-torsors over a base scheme S, almost certainly lecture or teaching notes. The archive title 'Théorie de Kum[m]er' supports this, and the sheets are written on the backs of 1980 Montpellier university notices.

(1) Start from the Kummer sequence 1 → μ_n → G_m → G_m → 1, where the last map is t ↦ t^n. It is exact in the étale topology if n is invertible on S, and in the fppf topology in general. Its long exact cohomology sequence begins
0 → H^0(S,μ_n) → H^0(S,G_m) → H^0(S,G_m) → H^1(S,μ_n) → H^1(S,G_m) → H^1(S,G_m).
The first line on the page writes it with one H^0(S,G_m) term omitted.

(2) The second line rewrites this concretely:
μ_n(S) → G_m(S) → G_m(S) → Rev(S,μ_n) → Pic(S) → Pic(S).
- H^1(S,μ_n) is identified with Rev(S,μ_n), the group of isomorphism classes of μ_n-torsors ('revêtements' of type μ_n).
- H^1(S,G_m) is identified with Pic(S) (Hilbert 90).
- The last map is multiplication by n, drawn as a vertical arrow labelled ·n (the transcription's ⊗n is also apt).

(3) Extracting the short exact sequence gives
0 → G_m(S)/G_m(S)^n → Rev(S,μ_n) → {}_nPic(S) → 0,
where {}_nPic(S) is the n-torsion of Pic(S). The page writes the first term as 'G_m(S)_n'.

(4) The coboundary is made explicit. A unit a ∈ Γ(S,O_S^*) is sent to the torsor Spec(O_S[T]/(T^n − a)), on which μ_n acts by T ↦ ζT. In the affine case S = Spec A this is A[T]/(T^n − a).

(5) The surjection onto {}_nPic sends a torsor to the line bundle L given by its χ-isotypic component, where χ is the tautological character. A trivialisation L^{⊗n} ≅ O_S then recovers the torsor as Spec(⊕_{i<n} L^{-i}), with algebra structure defined using that trivialisation.

Purpose: to classify cyclic μ_n-coverings of a scheme, the standard first step of Kummer theory, presumably for a course or a seminar exposition.
errors: The first line omits the middle term: after H^0(S,G_m) there should be the n-th power map to a second H^0(S,G_m) before the coboundary to H^1(S,μ_n). The second line restores it.
'G_m(S)_n' must mean the cokernel G_m(S)/G_m(S)^n, not the n-torsion of G_m(S) (that would be μ_n(S)). The notation is ambiguous, or a slip.

The page states no hypothesis. Exactness of the Kummer sequence needs n invertible on S for the étale topology, or the fppf topology otherwise. Spec O_S[T]/(T^n−a) is a μ_n-torsor only because a is a unit, and is étale only when n is invertible.

deep.surprise_reason: Entirely standard textbook Kummer theory, apparently teaching notes. The only details of interest are the notation 'Rev(S,μ_n)' and the small slips.
transcription_corrections: The last map in the vertical column is multiplication by n (labelled ·n or ⊗n), from Pic(S) to Pic(S).
In the second line, the final term reads 'Rev(S,μ_n)' (abbreviated 'Rev' in the handwriting).
'Spec' is written in a cursive form resembling 'Spec' with a flourish. The final target in the short exact sequence is {}_nPic(S), written roughly as 'nPic(S)' at the right edge.
